(345)༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim gnyis 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'bebs pa chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (345)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim gnyis 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rdo rje 'bebs pa chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(346)༄༅// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ /rnam kun mchog ldan thig le stong pa drug /'gyur med bde ba stong chen yi ge lnga// snyoms zhugs 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje'i ye shes stsol// thog mtha' dbus gnas dus dang yon tan med// skad cig gcig gis byang chub thams cad mkhyen// ye shes rdo rje phyag rgya chen mo la// gsol ba 'debs so= /mchog tu mi 'gyur skye 'jigs spangs pa'i bde// rnam pa lnga yis byang chub ye shes sku// thugs kyi rdo rje dang po'i sangs rgyas la// gsol ba= /gzhom med sgra brnyan bden don bcu gnyis pa// rnam pa nyi shus byang chub nyin mor byed// gsung gi rdo rje dus kyi 'khor lo la// gsol ba= /zhi ba'i gzugs brnyan de nyid bcu drug rig /sgyu drwas byang chub pad+ma 'dab rgyas spyan// sku yi rdo rje shākya thub pa la// gsol ba= /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od bzang po// lha (347)dbang gzi brjid zla byin lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan la// gsol ba= /sa bcu'i dbang phyug tshogs kyi sprul pa'i sku// 'jam dpal grags pa pad+ma dkar po sogs// rigs ldan nyer lnga phyed skyong dum skyong la// gsol ba= /'jam pa'i rdo rje rgyud kyi bdag po'i bdag /shrī bha dra sems 'grel mkha' khyab spel// rdo rje'i sku brnyes dus zhabs che chung la// gsol ba= /bo dhi bha dra las chen thogs med 'grub// so ma nā tha phra rags zag pa zad// mchog gi grub pa paṇa chen rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /shes rab grags pa gzhom med sgra skad bsgyur// sgom pa kun mchog spyan snga chags med 'chang*// sngags mchog rig pa'i bdag po nam gnyis la// gsol ba= /sgro ston gnam brtsegs 'pho chen rdū tir bcings// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes mkha' la spyod// nyi zla'i bgrod pa dag pa rnam (348)gnyis la// gsol ba=

/chos kyi dbang phyug gnyug ma'i chos gter brdol// nam mkha' 'od zer mkhyen rtogs gzi 'od 'phro// lung rtogs chos kyi phung po rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /ḍā ki jo 'bum lhan skyes lang tshos sgeg /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dus gsum sa ler gzigs// ye shes lus can lcam dral rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /shes rab 'od zer shes dang shes bya'i bdag /chos sku 'od zer 'od gsal phyag rgyas 'khyud// mchog thun grub pa'i rgyal po rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /kun spangs chen po phra rag rdul chos spangs// byang sems chen po byams pa'i go chas g.yogs// rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /mkhas btsun chen po yon tan rgya mtshor 'khyil// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen dol po pa// rgyud 'grol man ngag shing rta chen po la// gsol ba= /sgra bsgyur sku mched nā da'i rang sgra sgrogs// phyogs las rnam rgyal sgrib gsum g.yul las rgyal// rgyal tshab sa brnyes skyes chen rnam gsum la// gsol ba= /kun dga' dpal ba shes bcu rnam dag 'chang*// kun dga' blo gros rnam bcu'i dbang dang ldan// nang gi sa bcu'i mthar son rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /dkon mchog bzang po gnyis 'dzin 'ching ba bcad// nam mkha' chos skyong rtogs pa mkha' dang mnyam// rim gnyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /nam mkha' dpal bzang rnam shes rgyal khams brgal// (349)rat+na bha dra 'khor lo bde bas gang*// mkhas mchog smra ba'i seng ge rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /'jam mgon grol mchog gnas gsum 'du ba thob// lung rig rgya mtsho srid med srid par gnas// nges pa don gyi mkhas grub rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /srog dang thig le stong pa'i gzugs kyis bcings// pad+ma rdo rje nyi zla'i dbus su zhugs// gsang bdag rdo rje sems dpa' sgrol ba'i mgon// gsol ba= /ye shes rgya mtsho dwangs ma sgrib bral smin// rin chen rgya mtsho stong gzugs bde bar grub// 'gran zla kun bral rgyab tshab rnam gnyis la// gsol ba=

/blo gros rnam rgyal bden don mkha' khyab rtogs// ngag dbang phrin las byin brlabs gzi byin 'bar// mngon sum lam gyi srog 'dzin rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /kun bzang dbang po zag med bdud rtsis myos// tshe dbang nor bu rlung sems dbang du mdzad// brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /bstan pa'i nyin byed ye shes 'od brgya 'phro// phrin las rnam rgyal dga' bzhi'i rtse mo 'chang*// rlabs chen 'gro ba'i ded dpon rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /pad+ma nyin byed rtag bde'i rgyal thabs skyong*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs brgya'i 'khor los sgyur// sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba= /yang na/ ngag dbang phrin las kyi rjes su/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal yid dpyod mtha' las rgyal// kun dga' chos 'phel kun dā 'phel zhing brtan// des don bstan pa'i srog 'tsho rnam gnyis la// (350)gsol ba= /ngag dbang dri med 'pho ba'i dri ma bcos// ngag dbang chos 'phel 'od gsal mkha' khyab 'phel// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnam gnyis la// gsol ba= /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ston mdzad bka' drin can// rtsa ba'i bla ma= /sogs/ khyad chos bzhi ldan brtags pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor gsal snang gi// rab mthar phyin pas zhi sogs las chen 'grub// sngags kyi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// ltos med bzhi yis rnam pa thams cad pa'i// 'char sgo 'byams klas nyams rtsal phyogs med rgyas// rgyud don mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la// yid ches rnam gsum thob par byin gyis= /mi g.yo gsum ldan mi rtog nang gi mkhar// rnam shes yul dang yul can 'brel pa bcad// stong pa'i yul la ye shes dbang po zhugs// 'od gsal rtags bcu rdzogs par byin= /srid gsum gzugs brnyan rang gi sems nyid dang*// ro mnyam yan lag lnga po mthar phyin pa// bsam gtan thog mar dge ba'i bsnyen pa yis// rdo rje bslang ba 'grub par byin=

/rdo rje gsum bzlas byed pa bcings pa yis// srog gzugs rab grub nyi zla'i rgyu pa 'gag /mun chen dbyings su srog thur mnyam par 'dres// 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byin= /rlung gi gong bu mi shigs dpral bar thim// gzhom med sgra sgrogs 'bar zhu'i bdud rtsi'i brlan// bar du dge ba nyer sgrub rdo rje'i me// lha sku'i 'du 'phro shar bar= /(351)phyag rgya gsum sbyor dga' bzhi rjes dran pas// bde stong 'phel brtan 'khor lo'i bdag po yi// lus las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dag pa'i gzugs brnyan gsal bar byin= /nyi rdul tshogs pa nor bu'i rtse mor brtan// byang sems zla ba gtsug tor dbus su nya// mthar dge ting 'dzin sgrub pas dbugs 'gags nas// zhu bde 'gyur med 'grub par byin gyis brlobs// sbyang gzhi sku dang 'od gsal rdo rje'i bzhi// sbyang bya 'pho ba kun spyod gnas skabs bzhi// sbyong byed rnam thar dag pa de nyid bzhis// sbyangs 'bras byang chub mkhyen bzhi mngon gyur shog /srid pa'i rnam pa gzhom med rab sad nas// dngos dang dngos med gcig gyur ma ning dngos// khams gsum dbang phyug mkha' khyab zung 'jug sku// dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di 'ang yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i sgron me thar rtse mchog sprul rin po che'i bka' ltar yon tan rgya mtshos nag zla'i gral tshes bzang por gus pa chen pos bris nas gsol ba btab pa dge legs 'phel/// / ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo lhan skyes kyi rgyun khyer dang rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa stan thog gcig pa'i dmigs sdom lhan skyes grub ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /na mo gu ru shrī kā la tsakra ya/ 'dir lus kyi gnas lugs lha sku dang sems kyi gnas lugs bde bar shes te spros pa la mi dga' bar ye shes kyi lha sku dang rnam pa mtshungs pa'i rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len (352)par 'dod pas skyabs sems spyi mthun bya// dngos po med la sgom pa med// sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do// zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid// mchog tu bde bas gzugs med pa// de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod// rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyis ni// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa nyid// lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni// bzhin lag kha dog rnam par ni// skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas// lus thogs bcas rdul chos kyi dbyibs spangs pa dang*/ sems rtog bcas blos btags kyi sgrib pa spangs pa 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po dang*/ srid pa gsum na gnas pa mtha' dag gzigs pa'i stong nyid kyi ye shes rnam par dag pa ngo bo dbyer med pa kha sbyor lhan cig skyes pa'i skus mtshon pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing*/ phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mthe bong ser po// mdzub mo dkar po// gung mo dmar po// srin lag nag po// mthe'u chung ljang gu/ phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs phreng dang po nag po// gnyis pa dmar po// gsum pa dkar po// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid du mtshon pa'i (353)dbu rgyan can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa rdo rje'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ gnyis ka'ang mtshon cha spangs pa'i lag pa gnyis pa dman pa'i tshul can/ kha dog lnga pa'i me'i dbus na khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

gcer mo rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing dbu skra phyed grol pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la snyoms par zhugs pa'o// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// lte bar ho ser po// gtsug tor du haṃ ljang gu/ gsang ba sngon po rgyal ba rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ yang na/ gsang bar swā sngon po// gtsug tor du hā ljang gu bsgom/ thugs kar zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du brtan g.yo 'khor 'das ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i snying po rnam bcu dbang ldan brtsegs pa mchog gi don du sngon po'am/ las thams cad par kha dog ljang gur gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gsal/ slar (354)'dus te snying por thim par bsam la/ oṃ ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ snod bcud stong nyid 'od gsal du bsdus nas mnyam par bzhag cing*/ slar gnyug ma'i lha sku ru ldang*/ rigs su skye dang sogs/ lag pas rdo rje sogs/ lha mo tshad ma sogs thun mong min pa'i smon lam dang*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub sogs dge bsngo bya'o// 'di ni bskyed rdzogs thun mong la ltos pa ste rdzogs rim kho na'i sngon 'gror lhan skyes bsgom na snod bcud sbyangs bsdu'i rjes su lha sku la sems 'dzin pa ma gtogs bzlas pa'i rtsol ba mi dgos so// zhes pa ni bsdus pa'i tshul gyis lhan skyes sgom pa'i thabs so// ༈ /spros pa bral yang don du gsal// gcig nyid rnam pa thams cad la// rtog pa med la 'gyur med bde// zung 'jug de la phyag 'tshal lo// dben par 'chi bas rgyud bskul te// gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba brtsam// sems bskyed pas ni gzhan don gnyer// tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs// byang chub 'dod pas de 'dod bya// khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam// bla ma'i rim pa las 'ongs pas// gang la mos pa'i shugs yod pa// de la ye shes lhag par 'bar// nyon mongs rlan dang ma bral ba'i// lus sems tshang tshing myur du bsreg

/dam pa'i don nyid mthong bar 'gyur// rjes su dpag pa'i 'dra 'bag gis// mngon sum lam gyi gzhi bting ste// gnyug ma lhan cig skyes (355)pa yi// bskyed pa'i rim pas rtog bcas bsgom// lus ngag sems dang 'pho ba la// rnam par mi rtog ltos med par// bya byed smra brjod rnam rtog gis// dben pa gsum la thog mar bslab// phyis nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ni// dwangs ba'i chu la gzugs brnyan bzhin// dben las rab tu skye bar 'gyur// lam gyi gzhi dgong pa rnams so// dang por mun pa'i khang bu ru// rdor skyil khu tshur brla steng bzhag /rgal tshigs bsrang la ro stod 'gyed// mgrin dgug lce rtse rkan la sbyar// ha cang 'byed 'dzum bral ba yi// mig dag steng du bzlog nas ni// bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// smin ma'i dbus su sems byas te// mi bzang mun pa lta bur ni// nyi ma gcig tu yongs su brtag /du ba smrig rgyu mkha' mar ma// sgrub pos dang por mthong bar 'gyur// de nas sprin bral nam mkha' la// 'bar ba zla nyi rdo rje dang*// mchog gi cha dang thig le'o// rlung sems 'gyu ba so sor bcad// ngag la sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs// yan lag dang po'o// stong pa'i gzugs la sems bsdus te// de nyid blo yis ma reg par// mnyam rjes ngo bo goms pa las// spros bral shes rab dang por skye// sems su rtogs pa gnyis pa'o// mtshan bral spyod pa gsum pa ste// lus sems dga' ba bzhi pa'o// 'dres las shin tu sbyangs pa yi// bde bas bsam gtan yan lag rdzogs// chos lnga ldan pa'i thig le'i dbus// sangs (356)rgyas gzugs su du mar snang*// mngon shes lnga po 'grub par 'gyur// yan lag gnyis pa'o// byed bcings bgegs mthar byed pas blta// rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa lam sbyong*// rlung gzugs sems gsum cha mnyam ste// 'jam rtsub gang btang bum can gyis// srog ni dbu mar gzhug cing 'ching*// btsan thabs sbyor bas nyi zla bkag

/zla ba drug gis yon po 'gag /ye shes snang ba'i yon tan spyod// yan lag gsum pa'o// 'khor lo lnga ru bum can bsgrub// rlung sems a ba rdū tir bkag /mi shigs pa yi thig ler bstim// gtum mo sbar bas srog thur bsre// lce gsum bskyod pa'i sbyor ba yis// nang gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myong bya// bde drod nyams dang gzhom med sgra// srid gsum snang brnyan rab 'byams mthong*// yan lag bzhi pa'o// 'dug stangs 'khrul 'khor bzung bzlog rnams// 'byangs nas ye shes rang gi lus// las kyi phyag rgyar dbang po gnyis// bsrubs pa'i sbyor bas lugs 'byung dang*// lugs zlog skad cig ma bzhi po// stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mor bsre// zhu bde 'dzag pa med la bslab// rtsa 'dab ska ba'i thig les gang*// rang lus 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// rang sems lha sku phyag rgyar grub// yan lag lnga pa'o// spros bcas spyod la rtag gnas pas// chags pa chen po'i thig le yi// 'gros las shar ba'i lhan skyes dang*// stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo 'dres// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dbugs// 'gags (357)las khyab bdag de snyed 'phel// 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gags pas so// kun tu 'od la sogs pa thob// yas mar dkar dmar brtan pa las// bden don bcu gnyis de nyid ni// rnam pa bcu drug kun tu 'gyur// yan lag drug pa ste rdzogs so/// /thog mtha' bar du dge ba yi// rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub ni// yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor gyis// rdul mun snying stobs 'dzag bde dag /mi phyed rdo rje bzhi yi dngos// sems dpa' srid pa gsum gyi bdag /skye 'di nyid la mngon tu 'gyur// dad brtson brtul zhugs ldan pas so// gal te dam tshig la gnas na// g.yeng bas 'bras bu ma thob kyang*// yang srid bdun las mi 'da' bar// mchog gi go 'phang nyid la sbyor// ston pa'i bstan pa mkha' 'dra yang*// 'di las zab pa'i rnal 'byor med// rtsa ba'i rgyud las shin tu gsal// sa bcu pa yi 'grel pas bkral// grub brnyes du mas thugs su bstar// byin brlabs brgyud pa bar ma chad// bsgom na yid ches rtags tshad skye// 'di 'drar 'jug pa skal pa rab// dge bas brtan g.yo kun gyi srog

/zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa' yi// go 'phang bdag gzhan ma lus pas// rtsol ba med pa 'grub par shog /ces lhan skyes kyi rgyun khyer dang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi bsgom don rtsa ba'i tshig tho tsam bkod pa 'di dag kyang*/ zhabs drung rin po che'i bka' ltar blo gros mtha' yas da ri drās sa zla'i tshes bco lnga'i thun mtshams su dben khrod kun bde gling du bris pa dge (358)legs 'phel//

༄༅// sbyor drug stan thog gcig ma'i dmigs khrid mdor bsdus snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'gyur med bde ba'i thig le ni// sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'od gsal ba// dngos po kun gyi srog tu 'gro// mngon sum nyid du mthong bas 'dud// de la 'dir rdzogs rim thams cad kyi mthar thug pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa brjod par bya ste/ de'ang jo nang kun spang chen po la sbyor drug bka' srol mi 'dra ba bcu bdun gyi rgyun bzhugs shing thams cad thugs nyams su bzhes pa las khyad par du 'phags pa 'bro lugs kyi man ngag la/ ri khrod zhabs kyi bka' gsar pa bsnan pas gdams ngag gi zab khyad dang byin brlabs kyi drod tshad khyad par du 'phags pa rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po'i khrid gzhung ma bu rnams su gsal bar gsungs pa nyid myong khrid du rdzogs pa zhig gi dbang du byas te/ thun gcig gi khong ngam/ nyin zhag gcig la rdzogs par nyams su len par spro ba gang gis/ thog mar skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ lhan skyes bdag bskyed bcas yun ring thung long khyab dang bstun nas rdzogs par btang*/ gal te sngon 'gro tshad ma ma 'grub tshe skyabs sems/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas nges par med du mi rung bas mos gus kyis rgyud 'khul nges bya/ de nas lus gnad lta stangs sor sdud dngos gzhi dang mtshungs par byas nas/ lus byed rtsol/ ngag smra ba/ sems (359)dus gsum spros pa/ 'pho ba'i bag chags 'dzag bde'i chags rtog la mi ltos pa'i ltos med bzhi la brten nas lus bya byed/ ngag smra brjod/ sems rnam rtog gi spros pas dben pa'i dben gsum khyad par can rgyud la skye ba na chos spyi skad du zhi lhag zung 'brel dang*/ 'di nyid thun mong min pa'i rang skad du sor bsam gyi gzhi thengs pa yin pas thog mar goms shug chung ba'i skabs thun gyi phyed cha tsam dben gsum kho na la bsgril ba gnad du che zhing*/

de lta na sor sdud kyi nyams myong rang shugs su 'char bar 'gyur/ dngos gzhi sor sdud la/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor ni 'byor na mun khang du/ ma 'byor na shin tu gnag pa'i mun par/ rkang pa skyil krung bca'/ lag pa khu tshur brlar bzhag /rgal pa mdun rgyab dgye rgu med par drang por bsrang*/ mgrin pas ol mdud mnan/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig smin mtshams sor bcu drug gi nam mkhar ha cang 'byed pa dang btsum pa ma yin par mun pa nag thing de la gyen du bzlog pa'i tshul gyis blta/ yun thung du la'ang dam po grub na legs/ thog mar rlung ro lan gsum 'jam par dbyung*/ de mtshams rang bab rgyu ru gzhug /sems gnang gang yang yid la mi byed par rtog med du ci gnas bzhag /dben gsum goms shugs chung ba'i dbang gis bsam med kyi rnal 'byor gnad du ma song bar byings rgod kyi dbang du gyur na rig pa cur phyungs te lta stangs kyi lam nas nam mkha'i dbus su shes pa drag tu gtad/ da ltar ba'i shes pa la bzo ma bcos par rtsol med du bzhag shes na mnyam bzhag gi skyon 'byung ba'i yul (360)med pas bzo med du 'jog pa la rtsa bar bya/ lus gnad dgye rgu sogs dang sems gnad byings rgod sogs kyi skyon thebs pa la yun ring du bsgoms kyang myong rtags mi skye ba ma zad gegs ldang ba mang bas thog ma nas lus sems gnad legs par bcos shing btang snyoms dbang du ma shor ba shin tu gal che/ gnad du song na ring por mi thogs par rlung dbu mar zhugs pas bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin phyogs tsam mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/ du ba/ smrig rgyu/ mkha' snang*/ mar me bcas mthong bar 'gyur te mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor ro// de nyid cung zad 'gyangs nas sprin dang ser bu med pa'i skabs nam mkha' dwangs shing rgya che bar mthong ba'i sar/ rang gi lus grib mar bsdad nas nyi 'od mi phog par byas/ snga gro kha nub/

dgongs mo shar du phyogs pas mig la'ang nyi 'od dang gangs ri sogs ma phog par shin tu gdangs te 'bru tshugs su lta ba khro bo'i lta stangs kyis sprin med nam mkha' sngo sang nge ba la bltas te rang sems gsal stong dang dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag pas/ 'bar ba/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ rdo rje/ mchog gi cha/ thig le ste rtags drug po 'char/ snga phyi bsdams pa'i rtags bcu po de nges pa'i rtags yin zhing*/ dbang po'i khyad par gyis ma nges pa'i rtags snang mtha' yas pa 'char na'ang sor sdud kyi rtags snang stong gzugs mthong ba lam rtags nyid yin gyi bzang ngan gang du'ang rtog par mi bya'o// 'di skabs stong gzugs ji tsam mthong rung de la mig dang sems mi gtod par nam mkha' (361)rtog med du bzhag pa kho na ched du dgos so// bsam gtan ni/ lus gnad ngag gnad snga ma dang 'dra/ sems gnad stong gzugs kyi snang ba gang gsal gcig la sems bzo med gsal rig dang lta stangs bcas che re gtad/ lta mkhan mthong mkhan gyi rig pa rang ngo shes tsam la dgag sgrub med par bzhag pas shes pa nang du ma lus/ snang ba phyi ru ma lus/ brjod med spros bral la ngo shes kyi dran pa rgyun chags pa ni shes rab kyi yan lag /stong gzugs rang sems kyi snang char myong ba rtog pa'i yan lag /de'ang yul yul can sogs spros mtshan thams cad las 'das par shes pa dpyod pa'i yan lag /lus sems la sngar med bde bas khyab pa bde ba'i yan lag /ting nge 'dzin nyid bde bar shar ba g.yo med bde ba shin tu sbyangs pa'i yan lag ste/ yan lag lnga char yar ldan tu rdzogs pa na bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa yin zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags kyang*/ 'od 'phro ba/ phra ba/ 'tsher ba/ 'dar ba/ gzhig dka' ba ste chos lnga ldan gyi thig le'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan du ma can gyis mtshan pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rdo rje'i snang brnyan sna tshogs pa 'char bas/

kun rdzob las snang sgyu ma lta bur rang shugs su rtogs pa'o// 'di skabs thog mar stong gzugs gtad sa der mi brtan yal yol byed na de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar lta stangs rig pa thog mar gang du gtad pa de kar gzir bas rim gyis sems gtad pa der stong (362)gzugs 'dus shing brtan pa thob pa 'ong bas 'di gal shin tu che/ shes rab kyi yan lag skyes nas thog mar rde'u nag po lta bu mig lam du mi gzan pa'i dngos po chung ngu'i las snang dang bsres la goms nas las snang rgya je cher bsres pas/ mthar snang ba thams cad stong gzugs su 'char bar 'gyur ba'i sgra sogs la'ang de bzhin du bsre'o// stong gzugs la brtan pa ma thob na mnyam bzhag tu sor sdud kho na la gzir/ rjes thob tu las snang gang rung la che re lta ba'i mthong bya mthong byed dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin gsal la ngos bzung med pa de rang ngo shes tsam byas te bskyang bar bya'o// 'di skabs rnams su ye shes pheb pa'i lus nyams ngag nyams sems nyams byung tshe smyo ba dang rlung nad sogs su bzung nas bcos byas na gegs shin tu che bas nyams byung rgyal du bskyang na legs pa'i yon tan yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel la/ spyir thun mtshams rnams su'ang lta stangs mi g.yo zhing*/ dran shes rgyun chags su brten na lam gyi yon tan myur du skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag gi sku rdo rje sor bsam gyi bsnyen pa thog mar dge ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i yan lag gnyis so// sor bsam legs par ma 'byongs bar du yan lag phyi ma bsgom kyang gzhung mthun gyi yon tan rgyud la mi skye bas lag len la'ang de 'dra'i rgyun med kyang thun gcig gi khongs su dmigs pa'i rnam grangs tsam la dga' bas 'brel 'jog lta bu byed par spro na/ byed bcings snga ma dang 'dra/ lta stangs thad ka las gyen du cung zad phyogs pa smin mtshams su thad kar hrig ger (363)blta/

dngos gzhi man lung pa'i mtshan brjod sbyor drug lugs 'di la gnad thams cad tshang zhing lag len bde bas/ thog mar sna g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas rlung ro dal ba dang drag po dang shin tu drag po gsum gsum ste dgu phrugs su 'bud la phyi 'dzin cung zad kyi tshe/ 'og sgo bsdams la thur sel shugs drag pos lte bar 'then/ steng rlung dal bus rngub pa de nyid oṃ gyi sgrar mos la lte bar mnan/ slar 'og rlung 'then zhing steng rlung mi thub na rngub chung dang bcas kha sbyor bum can 'dzin pa de hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs su sems gtad/ cis kyang mi thub tshe dal bus rgyu ba mi mngon pa tsam phra la reng bar āḥ'i yid bzlas bcas phyir btang*/ de lta bu brgya'am nyer gcig la sogs pa gang 'grub bya/ goms pa nas gnas pa je ring la 'gro bas tshar grangs nyung du bya/ gal te stong gzugs gsal na/ rlung phyir btang ba'i tshe stong gzugs la sems drag tu gtad/ nang du 'jug dus rlung gzugs sems gsum mnyam nyid du bsre/ gnas pa'i dus su 'dres pa'i myong ba'am bshigs te tshor mkhan gyi shes pa dbyings su yal ba la mnyam par bzhag pa shin tu gal che ba'i zab gnad do// lag len shes na thun mtshams su 'phur mnye/ rtsa sbyong sogs 'khrul 'khor skabs bstun byas pas dbu mar rlung sems rnams chug cing lte ba'i bum pa can 'grub par 'gyur ro// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa gsal gdab ste yas rim gyis lte ba la sogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi'i mi shigs pa'i thig le la rlung rnams thim par mos te bum pa can snga ma ltar bsgom (364)pa ni 'dzin pa'i mos bsgom rjes mthun pa ste 'di las gtum mo'i 'bar snang stobs su gyur pas bde drod dang gzhom med kyi sgra sogs 'byung ba yin no// de dag ni gsung rdo rje nye bar bsnyen pa srog 'dzin bar du dge ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i yan lag gnyis so// rjes dran kyang mos slob kyi dbang du byas te lus gnad spyi ltar la lag pa khu tshur snying gar bsnol/

lta stangs thad kar g.yo med du blta/ bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba dang*/ las rgya'am ye rgya gang rung sna tshogs yum du gsal// gnyis ka'ang stong gzugs dang ro gcig tu bsres nas yid mi g.yo bar cung zad bzhag /stong gzugs kyis rgyas gdab ma nus na lha sku gsal stong la sems bzung*/ spyi mgrin snying lte gsang ba gtsug tor drug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥswā haṃ dkar dmar nag ser sngo ljang gi rgyas btab/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po phra mos mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ste bar āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po phra mos mtshan par gsal btab/ rjes chags kyi spyod pa dang dbang po mnyam par sbyor bas dga' ba bzhi rim par skye ba re re la'ang bzung bzlog khyab pa'i gnad dang ldan pa'i mthar/ nor bur sleb pa na thur sel drag tu glod cing srog phyir bsal/ ma ning gi rlung shugs ldan/ nang gi gtun brdung*/ sems stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa ste sgo gsum la gnad bzhi dang ldan pas rtsa ltems rlung ldog /rba rlabs bzhi nas 'pho med (365)du gnas pa na hūm̐ ring dang thul sel bsnol ma'i khong 'dren gyis lug zlog tu bzlog /'khor la drug po re rer bzlog pa'i mthar yang stong gzugs la sems bzhag ste lus kyi gnas rnams drag tu gcud cing sprugs la bkram ste khyab par byas/ mthar bum can bsgom zhing zhu bde'i nyams dang 'od gsal stong gzugs la dmigs nas mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang skyong bas 'dzin 'dren bkram pa gsum pa gsum ka rang shugs su 'grub bo// 'di'i yan lag tu gtum mo'i dmigs pa bsgom par 'dod na/ rang lus lha sku khongs stong du gsal ba'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam pa ljang gu g.yas ro ma dmar mo// g.yon rkyang ma dkar po dbu ma las ldab 'gyur phra ba/

dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug dang ro rkyang sna bug la zug pa/ lte ba man chad dbu ma'i mar sne sngon po g.yas ro ma nag po// g.yon gyi char yod pa nyis gshib mar sne cung zad 'khyog nas gsang bar zug pa/ rkyang ma'i mar sne ser po dbus kyi phyogs bzung nas bshang lam du zug pa/ dbu ma'i yas sna nas sor gang tsam gyi 'og gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo ljang gu/ dpral ba nag /mgrin pa dmar/ snying ga dkar/ lte ba ser po ste 'khor lo lnga po rtsa 'dabs bzhi bzhi/ rgyu zhabs phyogs su gsang 'khor sngon po rtsa 'dab drug pa/ 'khor lo so so'i thad du ro rkyang gi lag re re dbu ma dang sbub 'brel ba/ 'khor lo rnams rtsa gsum la sked dkris byas pa las yal ga sbub can skyes (366)pa lta bu/ gtsug spyi mgrin gsum kha thur bstan/ snying ste gyen bstan bsgom/ gtsug tor gyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le dkar po ba'i nu ma lta bu/ lte bar gtum mo dbyug pa'i gzugs can dmar po gnyis ka'ang sor bzhi pa gsal btab/ rlung bum can dgang bas gtum mo'i me 'od rab tu rgyas te/ rtsa 'khor dang lus nad thams cad dmar 'ub khyab cing drod tsha 'ur gyis skyes/ thig le zhu bar dbu mar bab pa'i 'od dkar lam khyab cing bde khril khril byung bar bsam/ lan kha shas bsgom mthar 'bar 'dzag gtum mo la bstims nas mi rtog par bzhag go /'di dngos bskyed rim gyi phyogs su gtogs kyang rdzogs rim gyi bog 'don khyad par can yin pas 'di'i yan lag tu bzhag cing las dang po pa la gal che'o// 'di dag gis zhu bde 'dzag med bsgrub pa ni yon tan no// ting 'dzin ni/ lus gnad gzhan 'dra ba las lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/ lta stangs sna rtser dbab/ rjes dran ltar yas brtan dga' bzhi rdzogs nas/ mas brtan skabs 'khor lo so sor bum can bsgom zhing*/ 'khor lo re rer sa gnyis gnyis thob nas gtsug tor du bum can bsgom pa na ting nge 'dzin gyi sa bcu gnyis mthar phyin par mos/

bum can tshad ldan ma grub na rtsa 'khor so sor stong gzugs dang bde ba dbyer med pa la sems 'jog ste khu rdul rlung sems kyi tshogs pa dag nas 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum 'dzag bde'i bag (367)chags bcas spangs te sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i sems dpa'i gnas thob pa'i mos pa bya ste/ de dag ni thugs rdo rje dran ting gi sgrub pa chen po tha mar dge ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i yan lag go /'dir mkho ba sor bsam skabs byed bcings btsan thabs dang*/ srog rtsol skabs srog thur bsre ba rlung gi spog chog /rjes dran 'khrul 'khor khyad par sogs rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyi gsung sbyor drug khrid rgyas pa dang stan thog gcig mar gsal zhing*// 'on kyang las dang po pa'i mos slob la ni 'di tsam las lag tu theb par dka' bas 'dir yi ge mang gi dogs pas ma bris so// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug skyid sdug bzang ngan gang gi tshe yang mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi dang ma shor bar bskyang ba ni lam khyer mchog yin la rmi lam 'od gsal 'pho ba sogs kyi dmigs phran gzhan bsgom par 'dod tshe khrid gzhung nyid du gsal zhing*/ spyir yan lag drug po snga phyi rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel par gnas pas snga ma snga ma rgyud la tshad ldan skyes na phyi ma la dka' tshegs med pas thog mar sor sdud gnad du song nas brtan pa thob tshe rmi lam sogs gdams pa'i yan lag rnams shugs kyi nyams 'og tu tshud par 'gyur/ las dang po pa'i mos sgom yal yol tsam la ni gegs dang bog gnyis ka ha cang mi 'byung la/ lam rtags gzhung tshugs pa na gegs sel bog 'don tu mkho ba'i gdams ngag gzhan tu gsal te gal yang che'o// sngon (368)'gro dngos gzhi'i gdams ngag /rang gi nyams myong*/ bla mas ngo sprad tshul rnams shin tu gsang zhing gdams ngag 'di nyid ma thob pa la dpe yang bstan par mi bya/ gnyid sogs sgrib pa lnga'i dbang du mi gtong*/

khyad par bla ma dang chos la the tshom cung zad kyang mi bya/ rtags snang gang byung la'ang dga' spro skrag 'jigs sogs spangs te gdam ngag nges shes bskyed/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig ma nyams par bsrung*/ yan lag rnams kyang ci nus kyis bsrung zhing nyams chags su gyur pa la yig brgya bdag 'jug tshogs bskang me mchod sogs kyis phyir bcos shing bshags/ dus rtag tu thun mong min pa'i zab gsang la yid ches shing snying nas dad pas smon lam zab mo rnams yang nas yang du btab pas skye ba 'di'am gzhan tu mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi sku gdon mi za bar mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam// sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud// grub brnyes bye ba'i gshegs shul zla med pa// mkhas grub kun gyis mgrin gcig gsal mdzad pa// rmongs pa'i slad kyis ci byar rang mnyam phyir// dam pa'i gsung bskul ma ldog tsam bris pas// nongs pa bshags shing dge bas srid pa gsum// (369)'pho ba'i 'jigs bcom mi 'gyur bde thob shog /ces pa'ang seng ge dang nā da'i sgra dbyangs can 'od gsal phyag rgya chen pos 'khyud pa mañdzu shrī'i bka' nan phebs pa ma ldog tsam du rnal 'byor gyi gnas la mos pa lam du byed pa gu ṇas bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
